test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

P. application, which can also be used to log complaints about

Q. littering or caused by the animals, according to officials

R. registered with the local authority through a mobile phone

S. the residents of Noida can now get their pets like dogs or cats
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. **'SRPQ'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **When we rearrange** the parts according to option** SRPQ,** we get a coherent and logical sentence:
 
• **"S.** The residents of Noida can now get their pets like dogs or cats
 
• **R. **registered with the local authority through a mobile phone
 
• **P. **application, which can also be used to log complaints about
 
• **Q. **littering or caused by the animals, according to officials."
 
• The **sentence starts by** stating what residents can do (get pets registered) and** then explains how they can do it** (through a mobile application) and what else the application can be used for (log complaints about littering caused by the animals).
 
• The phrase** 'according to officials' **at the end refers to the** source of this information.**
 
• **This makes a **logical, clear, and grammatically correct sentence.

Therefore, the **correct order** of sentence is: **'SRPQ'.**
